description: After in-place compaction refreshes the system prompt, the context card shows only the latest one. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}}'s history, as the page loads it, has its original system prompt and then two refreshed copies, "Refreshed system prompt 1" and "Refreshed system prompt 2"; the page's live stream is cut off. "The card" is the element with data-testid "generation-context". 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. There should be exactly 1 element matching '[data-testid="generation-context"] > .system-prompt-view' (a direct child of the card). 3. Click the card's button (role "button", within the card) whose name contains "System Prompt:". 4. The card's ".system-prompt-text" should read exactly "Refreshed system prompt 2". 5. The card's ".model-bar" should be visible.
